description: This file defines the `AccrualActivityPostingBusinessStep` class, which implements a business step for posting accrual activities on loan accounts during COB (Close of Business) processing. It uses services to process accruals for a loan and provides descriptive names and logs processing steps.

classes.name: AccrualActivityPostingBusinessStep
classes.description: A business step component for posting accrual activities on loans during COB processing, implementing the LoanCOBBusinessStep interface.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the accrual activity posting process on a given loan, logging the process start and end.

methods.name: getEnumStyledName
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for the type of business step.

methods.name: getHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of the business step.
